ios.desc:
About the app : Clover lets you place orders, book appointments, and earn rewards at your favorite local businesses.
The new and improved Clover app makes supporting local businesses faster and more rewarding. Whether grabbing a quick coffee, booking your next salon appointment, or shopping, you can now discover and transact with local spots all in one place.
How it works:

- Discover local favorites: Explore a wide variety of local food, retail, and service businesses. Use our new interactive Map View or proximity-based feed to easily find the best spots near you.
- Order and book ahead: Skip the line with mobile ordering for pickup and delivery, or instant scheduling for your next appointment.
- Earn and burn points: Earning rewards is easier than ever. Track your points and find ways to instantly redeem them.
- Orders appointments: Keep track of your activity with each business. Easily view past orders and check upcoming bookings.
- Seamless checkout: Securely save your preferred credit cards for faster payments, or use Google Pay and Apple Pay.
